_comment: Ship generator taste (scripts/shipgen): the only hand-written part. Everything else (parts, rules, power) comes from the game. size.cells: grid cells the ship covers. band: what a pilot of that level can build (maxLevel; rarities). require/encourage select parts by power role (generator, store, conduit, diode, dynamo, weapon, thruster, tool, core), family (models.json) or fn id; min/max counts. example: a bundled blueprint shown as a worked example. shapes: silhouettes a design is asked for, one per trial (so a model has a target that is not the example). weights: check() score weights.

roles.name: Starter fighter
roles.summary: a small, cheap first ship: a couple of guns, a reactor and a battery, two engines

encourage.why: a battery between the reactor and the guns keeps them firing

style: Keep it small and tidy: a short nose, the core in the middle, two guns at the front corners facing ^, two engines at the back facing v.
A wedge or two of hull (shaped pieces) at the wing tips looks good but is optional.
shapes: a dart: narrow (5 columns) and long (7 rows), with a pointed nose
a flying wing: wide (9 columns) and short (4 rows), the guns at the wing roots
an arrowhead: wings swept back from a short nose, 7 columns wide and 6 rows long
a stubby brick: compact, 6 columns wide and 5 rows long, the engines in a block at the back

roles.name: Gunship
roles.summary: a brawler: as many guns as it can keep firing, armour at the front and sides

encourage.why: armour on the nose and flanks
a shield keeps it in the fight

style: Guns in a forward battery facing ^, turrets out at the flanks.
Armour across the nose and down the sides; the core, generators and stores deep inside.
Each group of guns gets its own store beside a generator.
shapes: a hammerhead: a wide armoured nose (12 columns) over a narrower body, 10 rows long
a long brawler: narrow (8 columns) and long (12 rows), the guns down the front half
a diamond: 11 columns wide at the middle, tapering to the nose and the tail, 10 rows long
a twin-boom: two gun pods on short arms either side of the core, 12 columns wide and 8 rows long

roles.name: Beam frigate
roles.summary: a mid-size ship built around beams and pulse lasers, with the generation to keep them lit
style: Lasers are hungry: put generators and stores right behind them.
A long, narrow hull with the beams forward and the engines in a row at the back.
Use Diodes to keep an engine or shield reserve that the beams can't drain.

roles.name: Missile boat
roles.summary: a stand-off ship: missiles and torpedoes, light armour, fast engines
style: Missile and torpedo launchers face forward (^) and need the cells ahead of them clear.
Keep it light and quick: good thrust for its mass.

roles.name: Hauler
roles.summary: a cargo ship: big holds, a tow beam or mining gear, a little self-defence

encourage.why: something to fill the holds with
a turret or two to see off scavengers

style: Cargo holds in a big block in the middle, hull around them.
Engines strong enough for the loaded mass.
Guns are an afterthought: a turret or two at the corners.

roles.name: Capital ship
roles.summary: a big warship in separate power grids: weapons, shields and engines each with their own generators

encourage.why: Diodes between the grids keep the engines' reserve from the guns

style: Build it as three grids in a row: weapons forward, shields in the middle, engines aft, joined by Diodes and Conduits.
Armour all round the outside; nothing vital on the edge.
Big guns forward facing ^, turrets out at the flanks, a wall of engines at the back facing v.
